description:
Cast Mirror-Mad Phantasm by paying {3}{U}{U}.
When Mirror-Mad Phantasm enters the battlefield, Renegade Doppelganger triggers, causing Renegade Doppelganger to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate Renegade Doppelganger by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Renegade Doppelganger into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.
